sections.measurement_note: Fresh 12 November M4 native-only verification, one numerical thread. Five measured generations after one excluded warmup per specimen. Actual Microgen+MMG is not rerun in this section. These are feasibility and repeatability checks, not comparative performance claims.
sections.timing_note: Charged cost is construction plus the selected public backend. Imports, fixed-fixture preparation and prior density calibration, independent identity/audit work and recorded instrumentation I/O are excluded.
sections.title: Final native feasibility: 30/30 admitted
sections.scope: Frozen final recipes cover the original four specimens, the TPMS catalog, anisotropic spinodoid, linear thickness/density grading, periodic grading and bounded primitives. The lattice explicitly uses historical min(f, 0.02); its zero sublevel set and ordered union are unchanged. Existing public Microgen primitive SDFs are used directly. Adaptive Tet4 recognition retains unit-distance box/cylinder branches; scalar defaults, bands and explicit-gradient policies stay unchanged. Earlier failures are retained in each case history. Strict study gates and caps stay unchanged; internal locked-corner roundoff handling is documented in project tracking. This is not universal geometry support: mapped/clipped TPMS and sampled OffsetGrading remain explicitly unsupported by the adapter.

Both meshes pass mesh admission; the separate six-load stiffness comparison does not establish FEA equivalence.
